title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Signature, Term and Term Credits
content:
## Agreement terms: commencement and credits

**Clause 1 — Signed acceptance.** An agreement under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements moves into its term only when a signed acceptance of the proposal is recorded against it. The record of the signed acceptance in the office's intake records is what satisfies this clause; the owner's statement that the proposal has been signed does not.

**Clause 2 — Validity of the proposal.** The signed acceptance must reach the office no later than the proposal validity period counted forward from the day the proposal was issued, counting calendar days with the day of issue excluded and the final day included; a proposal whose validity has lapsed is reissued at current prices rather than backdated. The proposal validity period is the tier's figure on the proposal desk sheet, and the day of issue is the proposal date on the agreement record.

*Boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-day validity).* A proposal issued on 1 June: day 1 is 2 June and day 30 is 1 July, so a signed acceptance reaching the office on 1 July is inside validity and one reaching on 2 July is not.

**Clause 3 — Term.** The term starts on the signature day unless the customer names a later start, and it runs for the tier's term length, ending on the day before the matching day of the month in which the term completes. A 12-month term starting on 10 April therefore ends on 9 April of the following year.

**Clause 4 — Term credits.** At the start of each term the agreement is credited with the tier's included visits — the sum of its preventive, inspection and filter change visits — and with the tier's annual repair allowance; both credits are recorded against the term they belong to, and neither carries forward into a later term. Unused visits and unused allowance are forfeited at term end. The same crediting is performed at renewal, at the renewed term's tier, and an agreement reinstated inside its own term keeps the credits it already carried rather than receiving a fresh set.

| Tier | Visits credited at the start of each term | Repair allowance credited at the start of each term |
|---|---|---|
| Filter & Belt Service Plan | 4 | the tier's annual repair allowance |
| Inspection Agreement | 2 | the tier's annual repair allowance |
| Preventive Maintenance Agreement | 8 | the tier's annual repair allowance |
| Labor Coverage Agreement | 8 | the tier's annual repair allowance |
| Full Coverage Agreement | 10 | the tier's annual repair allowance |
| Comprehensive Performance Agreement | 18 | the tier's annual repair allowance |

**Clause 5 — Reinstatement inside the term.** Reinstatement inside the agreement's own term brings no fresh credits; the visits and allowance already credited to that term continue to stand.
